note: Closes LandmarkPlacer.cs's own documented gap ('sign text dropped -- no canvas-label pipeline ported here') for the two real brand signs landmarks.js:44-60's `label()` paints: 'TBILISI MARRIOTT' (marriott(), landmarks.js:1160-1165) and 'RADISSON RED' (radissonRed(), landmarks.js:1202-1207). Ported as a generated Texture2D built from a small 5x7 bitmap font rasterised directly into the pixel buffer with plain array writes (no DOM canvas, no System.Drawing, no live Canvas+RenderTexture bake -- works identically under -batchmode -nographics) -- the same 'real geometry/data instead of a browser canvas' trade AirportBuilder.cs already made for the runway designators and helipad H's, applied here to an actual texture (the sign IS a textured quad in the JS, not flat 3D geometry, so a Texture2D is the correct target rather than more AirportBuilder-style dot-matrix mesh geometry).
